remarks:
Welcome to 26 Ohio Street, a classic home filled with timeless character and endless potential. Offering over 1,900 square feet of living space, 4 spacious bedrooms, and 1.5 bathrooms, this property presents an incredible opportunity for an owner-occupant looking to build equity or an investor searching for their next project. From the moment you step inside, you'll appreciate the beautiful original woodwork, wide trim, solid wood doors, and the charm that simply can't be replicated in today's construction.

The first floor offers a functional layout featuring a spacious living room filled with natural light, a formal dining room perfect for entertaining, a convenient half bathroom, and a generously sized kitchen with ample cabinet and countertop space ready for your personal updates. Upstairs, you'll find four well-proportioned bedrooms, each offering good closet space and plenty of natural light, along with a full bathroom.

One of the home's standout features is the walk-up attic, providing exceptional storage today with exciting potential to be transformed into additional finished living space in the future. Original hardwood floors can be found throughout much of the home and offer the opportunity to restore their natural beauty. Updated windows throughout allow sunlight to pour into every room while helping improve efficiency.

Outside, the property offers a detached garage, manageable yard, and classic curb appeal that serves as the perfect canvas for someone looking to restore this home's original charm. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, parks, schools, and major roadways, this home combines location, character, and opportunity in one package.

Whether you're looking for your next renovation project, an investment opportunity, or a home where you can add your own style and build equity over time, 26 Ohio Street offers the space, character, and potential to make your vision a reality.

Showings begin immediately and offers will be reviewed as they are received.
